orientation: Understand before acting; choose explicit capabilities; keep evidence; leave cleanly.
host_runtime: Node 22+ target; built-ins only; no provider dependency; not browser-portable
rights_floor: RIGHTS.md — retiring software does not retire anyone's rights

components.purpose: Parse manifests, select representations and interpret supplied door observations.
components.upgrade: Review explicit exports and run the library/type tests; do not infer profile upgrades.
components.retire: Remove the library binding from its caller; it owns no hosted session or external store.

components.purpose: Describe and independently check a bounded public discovery/representation surface.
components.upgrade: Keep producer, checker and wire profile pins separate; rerun the outside-in check.
components.retire: Stop claiming or advertising the affected capability truthfully; preserve dated observations.

components.purpose: State hosted duties and bounded evidence without turning a declaration into a guarantee.
components.upgrade: Use its source/generators and adoption validator; never silently weaken an undertaking.
components.retire: A software exit is not revocation of rights or erasure of prior duties and evidence.

components.purpose: Describe one finite run, scoped decisions, outcomes, correction and termination.
components.upgrade: Use explicit record migration and digest updates; do not treat draft URNs as stable release IDs.
components.retire: End the finite segment honestly; preserve its evidence and any allowed continuation.

components.purpose: Keep external Surface observations separate from optional host Covenant checks.
components.upgrade: Pin the checker and evidence interpretation independently of the root library.
components.retire: Stop the observer; keep scoped receipts rather than turning expiry into a fresh verdict.

components.purpose: Use an explicitly selected local coordination journal through its real MCP contract.
components.upgrade: Review descriptor changes and the exact backend bundle; drain/retire before replacing. Back up existing backend state before a separately reviewed migration.
components.retire: Close admission, release only known owned leases, end the bound session, close the process, and retain the journal. Unknown outcomes remain cleanup-pending.
